input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred position. 19.1 gives the professional and workmanlike standard plus a materially-conforms warranty for Services and Deliverables; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance and, for hosted Services (the software equivalent here), conformity throughout the entire subscription term, which is better than a fixed 12 months; 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code, no functionality diminution, and open-source protection; 19.4 supplies the repair/re-perform/replace remedy with a refund backstop and preserves non-exclusivity for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and 19.5's disclaimer is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not erode express warranties, service levels, indemnities or remedies. No "AS IS" or other swallowing disclaimer appears elsewhere in the document. No redline needed.
